description.text: Adler fixes on you: 'Defend the claimant.' You have the precedent ready, and lay it out cleanly; a few classmates glance over, reassessing.
Adler fixes on you without warning: 'Defend the claimant.' You stumble through it, half-remembering the reading, and sit down hot-faced — but you will not forget this case again.

description: After the lecture a professor holds you back a moment. 'You have promise,' she says. You feel emboldened — perhaps you could hold your own in a duel now.
